title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Qurbani in Hajj( Tamatuu ) 6965 views Q. I am working in Jubail, K.S.A. Last year I performed Haj along with the Dawah Center of Jubail with Tashree (Permission to Perform Haj from Saudi Government. I had a small doubt i.e. as we are performing Haje-E-Tamattu. We performed Umrah and then they alloted accomodation in Muzadalifa and they are calling as extension mena. during Haj We have to stay in Mena and perform Salah in mena but we are in muzdalifa, so it is permissible to stay in extension mena and offer salah. Please advise what to do. 1580 views Q. I am going for umrah catching a flight from mumbai to jeddah via yemen(sana) ......can i wear ihram in yemen 1524 views Q. Can those of us who are menstruating stay at the hotel in Makkah while the rest of the family performs umra? 1700 views Q. Tawaf e ziyara and wida 16095 views Q. I want to know that if i am going to makkah for umrah from india, can i make niyyat and offer two rakat from bombay in pant and shirt and wen i reach jeddah i will change my clothes and wear ihram on jeddah airport. is it right to do that? 4485 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 50093 Country: Pakistan Title: Injury during Hajj Question: During hajj 2013-last day in Ihram, one woman hit her wheel chair at back of my foot and I got minor wound with blood come out. I asked Hajj fellows and they suggested that it was not your mistake still you give sadqah, which I have given around 3000 Pak rupees. Kindly guide me further and pray for me. Answer ID: 50093 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 241/200/H=02/1435) There is no dam or sadaqah if you are hurt or even blood comes out even in the state of ihram. However, if you paid sadaqah on someone’s advice, you will get its reward in this world as well as hereafter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
